verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE logo is tiny and jammed into the top-left corner, and the bottle cap nearly touches the top edge. The headline and copy cluster at the top centre and leave dead space underneath, so the hierarchy feels weak. B: the brand is legible and the headline-then-CTA order reads well, but it is cramped. The bottle spans almost the full height, the headline's 'fizz' runs into the muddy pair of overlapping circles, the copy wraps to 3 lines, and the oversized CTA crowds the right edge. Neither would ship; I picked B narrowly because its brand and hierarchy survive better.
